judge: Two judges, each a Claude agent shown only the match sheet's claims and truth, not which method made the claims, ruled on every claim without seeing each other's rulings. An adjudicating agent ruled on each claim where they differed. Rules: the same problem at the same place; a general claim states nothing; when unsure, no match.

matches.note: The G0.1 index lists A7.1 Roof Plan, and the set has no such sheet. This is index_extra.
The claim says G1.2 through G1.4 show only Stair 1 and that each story of the 4-story building needs two exits. G1.4 is the fourth floor, so this states too few stairs there.
The Stair 1 marker on G1.2 gives a 50-person capacity, below the required load. This is exit_capacity. No truth item covers the width conflict.
The claim is about the exit enclosure taking in the hall with unit openings. No truth item covers this.
The claim says G1.1 shows no exterior discharge for the stair or hall. It does not say the stair is missing or not drawn on the first floor plan A1.1, so it is not stair_discharge.
The claim is about the missing 2-hour enclosure rating for Stair 1. No truth item covers this.
The claim is about door fire ratings in the schedule. It does not mention door 1004 missing a row or the type conflict for door 3004.
The claim is about the corridor fire rating on A1.1. No truth item covers this.
The claim is about emergency escape openings and window data. No truth item covers this.

The claim is about the revision cloud at Stair 1 on A1.3 and asks in general terms for exits and ratings to be shown. It does not mention door 3004, and no truth item says the third floor has too few stairs.
